checks: Verify archival hashes, bind each UID to episode/frame/crop, distinguish the last observed prefix from a previous search candidate, inventory spatial maps and saved tracker fields.

interpretation: A readiness count is not a tracker result. A previous available candidate is not automatically a reliable target observation. Missing saved fields cannot be filled with ground truth for operational scoring.
